post.title: Quicken rents you your own checkbook. Home Ledger is free.
post.caption: Two fresh grudges: a checkbook that skips the Quicken subscription, and a phone webcam that skips the paid app, the ads and the developer mode.

segments.gripe: Your own checkbook, on a subscription.
segments.quote: the parts of Quicken most people actually use, without the subscription.

cues.cap: So: Home Ledger. Your money, your file.
cues.say: [quick] So: Home Ledger. Your money, your file.

segments.gripe: Your own phone as a webcam, for a fee.
segments.quote: the options were a paid app, an app full of ads, or something that wanted me to turn on USB debugging.

cues.cap: As a webcam. For a fee.

cues.say: [sarcastic] the options were a paid app,
to turn on U S B debugging.
[quick] So: My Cam. Plug in, done.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
